results.rejection_reason: WebMCPReady and AgentReady serve the same site-owner/developer customer and substantially the same core job of checking, preparing and documenting browser agent/WebMCP action readiness. Open-source Ora covers testing and verification. A generic registry plus signoff is insufficient differentiation without buyer proof.
results.review_note: Rejection is on substantial overlapping same-buyer workflow. Competitor pages do not demonstrate an exact persistent approval ledger; this difference is recorded instead of claiming feature parity. Zero external cash remains unverified but is not needed to reject the generic product.
